notes: *be thou like* is read as the rendering of דְּמֵה itself, so both comparative לְ prepositions are unrepresented, as in the parallel at v.9; the ethical dative לְךָ and its suffix are unrepresented too (rule 40).
The *and* before *be thou like* is added: סֹב דְּמֵה juxtaposes the two imperatives with no conjunction morpheme between them (rules 14, 30).
עַד שֶׁ is fused to *Until* (rules 23, 30), and *a young hart* is placed as at v.9, with the supplied indefinite article on the noun of the expression and the rectum's article unrepresented.
